description: List the direct child accounts nested under a given Canvas account — one level deep, not grandchildren or deeper descendants. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use `get_account` to fetch one sub-account's full details by ID, or call this tool again with a child's ID as `account_id` to walk further down the tree. Requires an admin role on the account.
name: list_sub_accounts
title: List Sub-Accounts
